name: Accurate
text: Keep up to x of the attack dice as normal successes without rolling them. Several instances combine into Accurate 2.

name: Balanced
text: The attacker may re-roll one attack die.

name: Blast
text: After the primary target, the same weapon attacks every other operative visible to and within x of it, friend or foe, as separate sequences.

name: Brutal
text: The defender may only block with crit successes.

name: Ceaseless
text: The attacker may re-roll every attack die showing one chosen result.

name: Devastating
text: Each retained crit immediately deals x damage to the target; with a distance, other operatives visible to and within it of the target take it too.

name: Hot
text: After the action roll a D6; if it is lower than the weapon Hit stat the user takes twice the roll as damage.

name: Heavy
text: The weapon cannot be used in an activation where the operative moved, and the operative cannot move after using it. A named exception (Dash only, Reposition only) is allowed.

name: Lethal
text: Successes rolled at or above x count as crits.

name: Limited
text: After x uses in the battle the operative loses the weapon.

name: Piercing
text: The defender collects x fewer defence dice. The Crits variant applies only if a crit was retained.

name: Punishing
text: If at least one crit is retained, one failed die is retained as a normal success.

name: Range
text: Only operatives within x of the shooter can be valid targets.

name: Relentless
text: The attacker may re-roll any of the attack dice.

name: Rending
text: If at least one crit is retained, one rolled normal success is retained as a crit.

name: Saturate
text: The defender cannot retain cover saves.

name: Seek
text: When choosing a valid target, enemies cannot use any terrain as cover.

name: Seek Light
text: When choosing a valid target, enemies cannot use Light terrain as cover.

name: Severe
text: If no crit was retained, one retained normal success becomes a crit.

name: Shock
text: The first time you strike with a crit in a sequence, also discard one unresolved normal success of the enemy (or a crit if it has no normal).

name: Silent
text: The Shoot action may use this weapon while the operative has a Conceal order.

name: Stun
text: If at least one crit is retained, the defender loses 1 APL until the end of its next activation.

name: Torrent
text: After the primary target, attack any other valid targets within x of it that have no friendly operative in their control range. Torrent 0 gives no secondary targets but still counts as Torrent.
